spanish-daily-plans-q1.explanation: The first-person pattern is voy a followed by the infinitive leer.

spanish-daily-plans-q2.explanation: Hora refers to the time of the activity.

spanish-daily-plans-q3.explanation: Mañana means tomorrow in this planning phrase; hoy means today.

spanish-daily-plans-q4.explanation: A clock time alone may refer to different instants in different places.
